symbols.name: scratch starting value
symbols.meaning: The starting value of a scratch wire, which may be any value.
symbols.quote: Let $\theta$ denote the starting value of a scratch wire, which may be any value.

symbols.name: written update value
symbols.meaning: A value computed from the data and added to the scratch wire, then subtracted again on undo.
symbols.quote: The computation adds a value $\gamma$ to the wire, where $\gamma$ is computed from data, so the wire holds $\theta+\gamma$.

relations.quote: The procedure is applied to a [Finite linear network with roles and frames](linear-network-roles.md), whose wires include the auxiliary registers.
